description: Na₂FeO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-31°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-35°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.63 Å. Fe is bonded to five O atoms to form FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-86°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.01 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with four ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-14°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids, and edges with seven ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-82°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with four ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-14°.
